full_page.content:
1946, January 14
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original message composed by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap. for his Golden Jubilee.
Jan. 14 - 1897
-
Jan. 14 - 1946
Thanks be to God for His
uncountable mercies - and to my
neighbor for his patient charity: fifty years in the Order have slipped, scarcely noticed ahead
of me, into eternal life.
Blessed be God in - all His designs : Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of:
Fr. Charles Repole, OFM.Cap.
Sacred Heart Friary
110 Shonnard Place
Yonkers, N.Y. 10703
